facts.fact: Clay 定调：警察不得入岛，岛上是一家人
facts.anchor: We do not need cops sniffing around. We protect our family, and here on Fear Island we are one big family

facts.fact: Marsh 抛出 Aaron 假释每周报到、已缺席两次
facts.anchor: He had a parole condition to check in weekly

facts.fact: Clay 口径：第三方背调没标记，我们已尽责
facts.anchor: I wasn’t aware of his record when he was hired. We run background checks through a third party

facts.fact: Clay 故意主动表示配合——无秘密者的标准动作
facts.anchor: people who have something to hide rarely volunteer their cooperation

facts.fact: Ares 清过监控，全岛录像有带修订时间戳的版本，无 Aaron 返回画面
facts.anchor: There is no footage of him returning

facts.fact: Clay 要 Kayla 亲口复述「我什么都不知道」，她照做并瞪他
facts.anchor: I know nothing,” she says, narrowing her eyes at me

facts.fact: Kayla 点破 Clay 的「我很好」防御：不必永远撑住
facts.anchor: But you don’t always have to be

facts.fact: 章末 Clay 确认：柔软版本只留给 Kayla
facts.anchor: no one else will ever get this version of me
